address: 125/21 Mu 6, Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Road, Salaya, Phutthamonthon, Nakhon Pathom, 73170, Thailand
bio: One of the best eateries in the area for noodle soup lovers, where the bouncy, MSG-free fish balls are made the traditional way from mackerel, yellowtail amberjack and wolf herring. The tom yum soup stands out; and the fish noodles are perfect for low-carb dieters as they go well with any soup....
